title: Adapt value-set: paired real historical prompts
description: Frozen dataset for Gate 0 (Adapt 4-arm retrieval+behavior A/B). Each row pairs a real historical prompt with (a) expected applicable rule ids from the current adapt pool, (b) category tag, (c) provenance hash. Pure domain labels, reviewer-owned.

id.description: Stable id for paired outcomes (Wilson etc.)

arm.description: preference_relevant = should be affected by an accepted rule; unrelated_control = no rule applies

expected_applicable_rule_ids.description: Namespaced adapt-* ids expected to inject; empty when arm=unrelated_control

expected_contraindicated_rule_ids.description: Rules that MUST NOT inject — used for intrusion scoring
